newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen Wien denies CEO resignation.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen Wien denies CEO resignation.

text.p: Austrian airport operator Flughafen Wien on Monday said market rumours that one of the group's two chief executives had resigned were unfounded.
Flughafen shares shed as much as 6.2 percent to 528 schillings on the Vienna bourse in early Monday trading before recovering to close at 549, leading the day's decliners in an otherwise flat market.
"The report is completely unfounded," Flughafen said in a statement.

It added that the two chief executives, Gerhard Kastelic and Franz Kotrba, had already publicly declared their desire to continue leading the company when their contracts come up for renewal in June. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
